title.value: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: “Your child needs surgery”: A survey-based evaluation of simulated expert consent conversations by key stakeholders

extractions.description: The study explores expert consenting practice from the key stakeholders' perspective in pediatric surgery. It identifies strengths and gaps in the current consent process from the perspective of patient families and providers to guide the development of a consenting educational video resource.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving the informed consent process in pediatric surgery and does not directly address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Consent conversations in pediatric surgery are essential components of pre-operative care which, when inadequate, can lead to significant adverse consequences for the child, parents, surgeon, and others in the healthcare system.
